preconditions.description: The number of records n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip() != '' for line in input_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains a valid non-empty operation record string.

preconditions.expression: all(op_type in ['insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'] for op_type in [line.split()[0] for line in input_lines[1:]])
preconditions.description: Every operation record starts with a valid command type: insert, getMin, or removeMin.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(parts[1]), int) and abs(int(parts[1])) <= 10**9 for line in input_lines[1:] for parts in [line.split()] if len(parts) > 1)
preconditions.description: For operations with arguments (insert, getMin), the argument is an integer with absolute value not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m+1 lines: the first line is the count m, followed by m operation records.
The first line of the output is the integer m, representing the total number of operations in the corrected sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(op_type in ['insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'] for line in output_lines[1:] for op_type in [line.split()[0]])
postconditions.description: Every line in the output sequence (after the count) is a valid operation record.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(parts[1]), int) and abs(int(parts[1])) <= 10**9 for line in output_lines[1:] for parts in [line.split()] if len(parts) > 1)
postconditions.description: All numeric arguments in the output operations are integers within the allowed range.

postconditions.expression: input_ops == [line for line in output_lines[1:] if line in input_lines[1:]]
postconditions.description: The original input operations appear in the output sequence in the same relative order (subsequence property).

postconditions.expression: all(heap_state_valid(op, heap) for op, heap in zip(output_lines[1:], [heap_after_i for i in range(len(output_lines)-1)]))
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations is valid: the heap is non-empty when getMin or removeMin is called, and getMin returns the recorded value.
The number of operations m is the minimum possible number of operations required to make the sequence valid while preserving the input subsequence.
